arxiv-2105-12305.title: SGPT: Semantic Graphs based Pre-training for Aspect-based Sentiment Analysis
arxiv-2105-12305.creator: Yong Qian † {\dagger}, Zhongqing Wang ‡ {\ddagger}, Rong Xiao † {\dagger}, Chen Chen ‡ {\ddagger}, Haihong Tang † {\dagger}
arxiv-2105-12305.description: Abstract Previous studies show effective of pre-trained language models for sentiment analysis. However, most of these studies ignore the importance of sentimental information for pre-trained models. Therefore, we fully investigate the sentimental information for pre-trained models and enhance pre-trained language models with semantic graphs for sentiment analysis.

arxiv-2506-04622.description: Abstract Interpreting peaks or dips that appear in an invariant mass distribution is a recurring challenge in hadron physics. One such enhancement is an exotic baryon Λ ⁡ ( 1405 ) \Lambda(1405) which was first observed in 1973.

britannica-1911-garibaldi-giuseppe.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-garibaldi-giuseppe.description: Article 'Garibaldi, Giuseppe' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 11), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. on board the frigate “Euridice,” plotted to seize the vessel and occupy the arsenal of Genoa at the moment when Mazzini’s Savoy expedition should enter Piedmont. The plot being discovered, Garibaldi fled, but was condemned to death by default on the 3rd of June 1834. Escaping to South America in 1836, he was given letters of marque by the state of Rio Grande do Sul, which had revolted against Brazil.

pmc-10582299.title: Acidification-based direct electrolysis of treated wastewater for hydrogen production and water reuse
pmc-10582299.creator: Ji-Hyung Han, Jeongwook Bae, Joohyun Lim, Eunjin Jwa, Joo-Youn Nam, Kyo Sik Hwang, Namjo Jeong, Jiyeon Choi, Hanki Kim, Youn-Cheul Jeung
pmc-10582299.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). This report describes the direct electrolysis of treated wastewater (as a catholyte) to produce hydrogen and potentially reuse the water. To suppress the negative shift of the cathodic potential due to an increase in pH by the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER), the treated wastewater is acidified using the synergetic effect of protons generated from the bipolar membrane and inorganic precipitation occurred at the surface of the cathode during the HER.

pmc-10599318.title: RNA-sequencing analysis reveals novel genes involved in the different peel color formation in eggplant
pmc-10599318.creator: Jing Li, Senlin Jiang, Guobin Yang, Yanwei Xu, Lujun Li, Fengjuan Yang
pmc-10599318.description: Eggplant (Solanum melongena L.) is a highly nutritious vegetable. Here, the molecular mechanism of color formation in eggplants was determined using six eggplant cultivars with different peel colors and two SmMYB113-overexpressing transgenic eggplants with a purple peel and pulp. Significant differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were identified by RNA-sequencing analysis using the following criteria: log2(sample1/sample2) ≥ 0.75 and q-value ≤ 0.05.

pmc-11428536.title: Development of Welfare Protocols at Slaughter in Farmed Fish
pmc-11428536.creator: Raffaelina Mercogliano, Alessandro Avolio, Floriana Castiello, Maria Carmela Ferrante
pmc-11428536.description: Simple SummarySlaughter and pre-slaughter practices can impact the flesh quality of farmed fish in a significant manner. Fish are sentient animals, able to experience emotions and psychological stress. They can perceive pain when killing methods are applied. European legislation does not adequately protect the welfare of farmed fish, unlike other animals.

pmc-11504029.title: Redox Signaling in Endosomes Using the Example of EGF Receptors: A Graphical Review
pmc-11504029.creator: Dana Maureen Hebchen, Katrin Schröder, Rosario Ammendola, Fabio Cattaneo
pmc-11504029.description: Early endosomes represent first-line sorting compartments or even organelles for internalized molecules. They enable the transport of molecules or ligands to other compartments of the cell, such as lysosomes, for degradation or recycle them back to the membrane by various mechanisms. Moreover, early endosomes function as signaling and scaffolding platforms to initiate or prolong distinct signaling pathways.

pmc-11607542.title: Echo chamber formation sharpened by priority users
pmc-11607542.creator: Henrique Ferraz de Arruda, Kleber Andrade Oliveira, Yamir Moreno
pmc-11607542.description: SummaryOn social media platforms, priority users (e.g., verified profiles on X) are users whose posts are promoted by recommendation algorithms. However, their influence on opinion dynamics, in particular polarization and echo chamber formation, is not well understood. Through computational modeling, we investigate this influence in a stylized setting. By introducing priority user accounts, we find that prioritization can mitigate polarization.

pmc-11678782.title: The Antioxidant and Anti-Inflammatory Activities of the Methanolic Extract, Fractions, and Isolated Compounds from Eriosema montanum Baker f. (Fabaceae)
pmc-11678782.creator: Gaétan Tchangou Tabakam, Emmanuel Mfotie Njoya, Chika Ifeanyi Chukwuma, Samson Sitheni Mashele, Yves Martial Mba Nguekeu, Mathieu Tene, Maurice Ducret Awouafack, Tshepiso Jan Makhafola, Artur M S Silva
pmc-11678782.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: Inflammation is a natural body’s defense mechanism against harmful stimuli such as pathogens, chemicals, or irradiation. But when the inflammatory response becomes permanent, it can lead to serious health problems. In the present study, the antioxidant and anti-inflammatory potentials of the Eriosema montanum methanolic extract (EMME), as well as its isolated fractions (FA-FJ) and compounds (1–7), were evaluated by using in vitro and cellular models.

pmc-11728775.title: Detection and Molecular Diversity of Brucella melitensis in Pastoral Livestock in North-Eastern Ethiopia
pmc-11728775.creator: Berhanu Sibhat, Haileeyesus Adamu, Kassahun Asmare, Johanna F Lindahl, Ulf Magnusson, Tesfaye Sisay Tessema, Rash Vemulapalli, Elaine Maria Seles Dorneles
pmc-11728775.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Brucellosis is a neglected zoonotic disease affecting livestock and humans that remains endemic in Ethiopia. Despite its prevalence, only a few studies have identified Brucella species circulating in livestock in the country. This study aimed to determine the Brucella species responsible for infections in livestock in the Afar region of Ethiopia and characterize the isolates using whole-genome single nucleotide polymorphism (wgSNP) analysis and in silico multi-locus sequence typing (MLST).

pmc-13219640.title: Dexamethasone-induced 3D cortical spheroid model of stress-related neuroplasticity impairment
pmc-13219640.creator: Mi Kyoung Seo, Jung Goo Lee, Jung An Lee, Ji Won Park, Deok-Gyeong Kang, Dae-Hyun Seog, Myoung Hun Kim, Sehoon Jeong, Sung Woo Park
pmc-13219640.description: Three-dimensional (3D) in vitro models of depression are valuable platforms for investigating disease pathophysiology, elucidating the mechanisms of antidepressant action, assessing drug efficacy, and facilitating the development of novel therapeutics. In our previous study, 3D cortical spheroids exposed to the synthetic glucocorticoid dexamethasone exhibited marked impairments in neuroplasticity, representing a key pathological feature of depression.

pmc-13439262.title: Lacosamide Use After Traumatic Brain Injury: A Scoping Review
pmc-13439262.creator: Hiroaki Taniguchi, Seigo Yamada
pmc-13439262.description: Lacosamide (LCM) is a newer antiepileptic drug that enhances slow inactivation of voltage-gated sodium channels and modulates collapsin response mediator protein-2, suggesting potential roles in seizure control and axonal protection after traumatic brain injury (TBI). However, its role in TBI remains unclear.

uslaw-usc-t2-s141.title: 2 U.S.C. § 141 — Allocation of responsibilities for Library buildings and grounds
uslaw-usc-t2-s141.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t2-s141.description: United States Code, Title 2 (The Congress); Chapter 5 (Library Of Congress). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Architect of the Capitol (1) In general The Architect of the Capitol shall have charge of all work at the Library of Congress buildings and grounds (as defined in section 167j of this title) that affects— (A) the structural integrity of the buildings; (B).

uslaw-usc-t34-s10251.title: 34 U.S.C. § 10251 — General provisions
uslaw-usc-t34-s10251.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t34-s10251.description: United States Code, Title 34 (Crime Control And Law Enforcement); Chapter 101 (Justice System Improvement); Subchapter VIII (Definitions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Definitions As used in this chapter— (1) “criminal justice” means activities pertaining to crime prevention, control, or reduction, or the enforcement of the criminal law, including, but not limited to, police efforts to prevent, control, or reduce crime.
